hardware: Base Apple M3, MacBook Air, 16 GB, 10 GPU cores, AC power
decision: No candidate adopted; production core and installed app unchanged
scope: PRL offline continuous hard-target pipelines and isolated K3 traversal screening; no pool connections or new external accepted shares. QTC was not changed or retested in this pass.

method.stream-screen: 60s baseline warmup, eight alternating forward/reverse rounds, five configurations, 3s minimum per sample. Independent continuous refill per lane; all in-flight jobs drained before timing ends. Config 0=4096-square/2slots/100%, 1=4096-square/3slots/100%, 2=4096-square/2slots/90%, 3=4096-square/2slots/80%, 4=2048-square/3slots/100%. K4096 throughout.
method.cpu-screen: 60s baseline warmup, eight forward/reverse rounds of native default/4/2/1 Rayon workers, 4s per sample; separate persistent processes, only one process active on GPU at a time. Shape4096-square/K4096/two slots/intensity100. Actual native default worker count was not instrumented.
method.cpu-long: 20s baseline warmup then four alternating default/1-worker pairs, 40s per sample (ABBAABBA), ~320s timed overall. Same production pipeline.
method.aspect-screen: 20s baseline warmup, eight forward/reverse rounds, 4s minimum per sample. 4096x4096, 8192x2048, 2048x8192, all K4096/two slots/intensity100 and equal ops per job; native default Rayon workers.
method.swizzle: Isolated native K3 host, existing 64x64/BK32/PF0/half-input kernel. Tag0=normal traversal; tag1/2/3/4=grouped row traversal with group sizes2/4/8/16. Each passed93 CPU-oracle cases over three vector sets, including limits and overflow cases. CPU enumeration verified bijective traversal on99 distinct grids for each candidate. Then30 alternating forward/reverse timed rounds per kernel at4096-square/K4096 using GPU timestamps; not production-pipeline wall rates.
method.gain: Each candidate rate / same-block baseline rate - 1. For swizzle use baseline GPU duration / candidate GPU duration - 1. Positive numbers favor candidate. Serial correlation/background load are uncontrolled; no formal significance claim.
method.units: TOPS=2*m*n*k/wall_seconds per completed job; one multiply-accumulate counts as two operations. Not directly comparable to QTC/NOID MH/s. CPU time is whole-process user+system seconds, including Rayon workers, not electrical energy.
method.coverage: Union of GPU command timestamp intervals / elapsed wall time; does not measure shader ALU occupancy.
method.limits: No GPU clocks/watts/temperature hardware counters. Other apps were left open; system thermalState readings are coarse. Short duty-cycle tests do not establish whether hours at lower intensity could benefit cooling. Hard-target throughput samples do not measure typical pool proof/submit overhead or acceptance.
method.failedHarness: Initial stream run stopped on duplicate intensity keyword while formatting a warmup result; corrected harness and reran fully (stream-fixed.log). Production source untouched.
